content: Chroma v2/v3: lexer := lexers.Get('go') or lexers.Match('file.go') for filename detection. lexer = chroma.Coalesce(lexer). style := styles.Get('monokai'). Terminal formatter: formatters.Get('terminal256') for ANSI output. Full pipeline: iterator, _ := lexer.Tokenise(nil, code); formatter.Format(w, style, iterator). For TUI use terminal/terminal256/terminal16m formatters, not html. Fallback: if lexer == nil, use lexers.Fallback. Same language database as Pygments - chroma v3 uses iter.Seq[Token].
